plan: Given my private value of $27, the optimal strategy is to bid just below my value to maximize profit if I win. Since all bidders are rational, they will bid up to their value. Bidding slightly below $27 increases my chance of winning without overpaying. I'll bid $26.9 to ensure I win against bidders valuing slightly less than me, maximizing my profit.

Given my private value of $16, I should bid slightly below my value to maximize profit if I win, while still having a high chance of winning. A rational strategy is to bid slightly less than my value to ensure profit if I win. Assuming others bid near their values, bidding $15.9 could win against a value slightly below $16, maximizing profit if they bid less.

Given my value of $31, I should bid slightly below this to maximize profit while still having a high chance of winning. Rational bidders would bid close to their value, but not exceed it, to avoid losses. A bid of $30.9 is optimal as it is close to my value, maximizing potential profit if I win, and it is likely to be higher than the others' bids, given their values are uniformly distributed between $0 and $20.
